manage.removeMessage: It goes away for the whole family, with who plays it and its settings. A pack goes with its modules, except those another pack gathers.
manage.removeForget: Also erase what everyone learned and the stats
manage.removeForgetOff: Otherwise, everything comes back if you install it again.
manage.removeForgetOn: Progress and played games will be lost for good.
manage.settingsHelp: Leave empty to keep the setting in grey: the pack's, the family's or the module's own. Stars: ★ from the threshold, ★★ from 90%, ★★★ with no mistake.
manage.catalogueHelp: The modules that come with Hopla. A pack installs all its modules, including those its updates add.
manage.importHelp: Paste or pick a module file in the hopla-module/1 format.
manage.noneHelp: Install a pack from the catalogue, then tick who plays it.
manage.packSettingsHelp: These settings apply to each module of the pack, unless the module has its own. Leave empty to keep the family's or the module's own.
manage.totalHelp: The cap counts the {{units}} of all games together, over a day. Leave empty for none.
manage.familyHelp: These settings apply to everyone, except whoever has their own in their pack or modules. Leave empty to keep the module's own. Stars: ★ from the threshold, ★★ from 90%, ★★★ with no mistake.
manage.readAloudHelp: What the device says in the modules made to be read aloud. Everything: the question, then each answer on the first tap (a second tap chooses it).
manage.firstNameHelp: For the questions about their first name (first letter, letters in order…). Empty: the first word of their name in Hopla.
manage.firstNameFor: First name of {{name}} in the games

detail.generated_one: {{count}} kind of exercise drawn at random
detail.generated_other: {{count}} kinds of exercises drawn at random
detail.familySettingsHelp: For everyone, except whoever has their own settings

voices.title: Voices of this device
voices.help: The voice that reads the questions in Learn. Each device has its own voices, so this choice is only for this device. Automatic takes the most natural voice installed.
voices.noVoice: No voice in this language on this device.

sample.fr: Bonjour ! Combien font sept fois huit ?

voices.getBetterHelp: Apple does not lend Siri voices to web pages: download a “Premium” or “Enhanced” voice, then open Hopla again.

ipad.title: iPad and iPhone
ipad.steps: Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices › French: tap a voice (Audrey, Thomas, Aurélie…) then download its Premium or Enhanced version. Same in English for the English modules.

mac.title: Mac
mac.steps: System Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › System Voice › Manage Voices: download a French Premium or Enhanced voice.

android.title: Android
android.steps: Settings › Accessibility › Text-to-speech › Google engine › Install voice data › French: choose a voice.

windows.title: Windows computer
windows.steps: In Edge, the “Natural” (online) voices are already there. Otherwise: Settings › Time & language › Speech › Add voices.

list.nothing: No module matches the search or the filters.
